name: merging-bubbles
title: Merging Bubbles
description: A small graphic of two circular bubbles fused into one peanut shape, each holding a supplied icon with a faint plus between them. It is used to show two tools or services connecting into a single integration.
use: A section should show two tools combining into one workflow without spelling the pairing out in a list.
avoid: It carries no text, so the pairing means nothing unless a caption explains which two things merged.
a11y: The graphic's only title reads "Outer glow/shadow", so screen readers get no sense of what the two icons stand for. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark blob shaped like two circles fused by a curved neck, with a thin light border and a faint outer glow. A database cylinder sits in the left lobe, a sparkle in the right, and a small faint plus marks the middle.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds; the two icons and the plus stay fixed in place.
customise: Pass any two icons as startIcon and endIcon, choose one of four sizes, toggle the centre plus, and colour it through the surrounding text classes.
weight: light: One inline vector of a few paths plus two icon slots; nothing runs at runtime.
